goal: Scale Kelo World into a persistent community-built MMORPG where maps, quests, NPCs, events and assets can be created, reviewed, versioned and published safely.

statusSemantics.contract-defined: Machine-readable contract exists and is protected by CI; production semantics are not yet complete.
statusSemantics.foundation-active: Shared runtime primitive exists and is exercised by the program audit.
statusSemantics.integrated: Connected to current Kelo World runtime owners.
statusSemantics.live-verified: Integrated and verified in LIVE/mobile evidence.

rules: Never mark a system integrated or live-verified without code, audit evidence and owner integration.
Protected value, rewards, persistence and competitive state are authority-owned, never trusted from the client.
UGC is versioned, attributable, dependency-aware, reversible and moderation-gated before broad LIVE reach.
Heavy world/content bytes are loaded on demand; metadata and dependency graphs are lightweight.
New work integrates with current Foundation owners and must not revive retired Legacy architecture.

systems.name: World Partition System
systems.doneWhen: Persistent cell ownership, deterministic coordinates, load/unload contract and migration-safe cell IDs.

systems.name: Seamless Shard Handoff
systems.doneWhen: Player transfers between shard authorities without duplicate ownership or visible reconnect.

systems.name: Dynamic Shard Split/Merge
systems.doneWhen: Hot cells split and cold cells merge while preserving entity identity and persistence.

systems.name: Area of Interest System
systems.doneWhen: Client receives only nearby/relevant entities with hysteresis and bounded subscription churn.

systems.name: Authoritative Entity Replication
systems.doneWhen: Server/authority owns competitive state; clients predict but cannot commit protected values.

systems.name: Delta State Synchronization
systems.doneWhen: Replication sends versioned deltas/snapshots with recovery after packet loss or version gaps.

systems.name: Persistent World State
systems.doneWhen: World mutations survive restarts and are replayable by cell/revision.

systems.name: World Event Ledger
systems.doneWhen: Append-only idempotent event log records durable world mutations and supports replay/audit.

systems.name: Cross-Region Replication
systems.doneWhen: Regional replicas converge with explicit conflict policy, RPO/RTO targets and no double-authority.

systems.name: Global Player Routing
systems.doneWhen: Players route by latency, capacity, party affinity and world ownership.

systems.name: Hot-Zone Autoscaler
systems.doneWhen: Capacity scales from live heat signals with cooldown, floor/ceiling and anti-thrash rules.

systems.name: Global World Clock
systems.doneWhen: Authoritative monotonic world time powers day/night, seasons and scheduled events.

systems.name: Dynamic Climate System
systems.doneWhen: Regional weather evolves deterministically/persistently and publishes gameplay effects.

systems.name: Living Ecosystem Simulator
systems.doneWhen: Resources/fauna populations react to harvesting, climate and regional pressure.

systems.name: World Event Director
systems.doneWhen: Director schedules bounded world events from live state with deterministic rollback and admin override.

systems.name: Creator Identity & Reputation
systems.doneWhen: Stable creator identity stores trust/reputation signals without granting authority by client claim.

systems.name: Creator Permission System
systems.doneWhen: Role/capability checks gate build, review, publish, moderate and revenue actions.

systems.name: Real-Time Collaborative Editing
systems.doneWhen: Concurrent edits converge using operation IDs, ownership/locks and conflict-safe transforms.

systems.name: World Version Control
systems.doneWhen: Every creator world mutation belongs to immutable revision history with diff and restore.

systems.name: Map Branching
systems.doneWhen: Creators fork isolated map revisions without mutating LIVE.

systems.name: World Merge Engine
systems.doneWhen: Three-way merge detects structural conflicts and never silently drops edits.

systems.name: Creator Staging Worlds
systems.doneWhen: Private ephemeral worlds pin an exact content revision for safe testing.

systems.name: Creator Playtest System
systems.doneWhen: Invite-scoped playtests capture revision-pinned telemetry and feedback.

systems.name: UGC Publishing Pipeline
systems.doneWhen: Draft→test→review→approved→staged→LIVE is explicit, auditable and reversible.

systems.name: UGC Rollback System
systems.doneWhen: Published content can revert atomically to a known-good revision with dependency checks.

systems.name: Asset Package Manager
systems.doneWhen: Versioned asset packages resolve hashes/dependencies and support immutable releases.

systems.name: UGC Dependency Graph
systems.doneWhen: Reverse/forward dependency queries expose blast radius before publish, merge or delete.

systems.name: Community Asset Registry
systems.doneWhen: Global paginated registry stores metadata only and streams asset bytes on demand.

systems.name: Quest Creator
systems.doneWhen: Mobile-first visual editor emits validated versioned quest definitions without arbitrary code.

systems.name: Quest Logic Graph
systems.doneWhen: Typed DAG supports conditions, objectives, branches, triggers and deterministic validation.

systems.name: Dialogue Creator
systems.doneWhen: Versioned dialogue graphs support choices, conditions and localized text references.

systems.name: NPC Creator
systems.doneWhen: Creator builds validated NPC definitions for appearance, faction, stats, inventory and behavior.

systems.name: NPC Behavior Editor
systems.doneWhen: Typed behavior graph exposes safe actions/conditions with execution budgets.

systems.name: Dungeon Creator
systems.doneWhen: Creators package instanced maps, encounters, checkpoints and completion rules.

systems.name: Raid Creator
systems.doneWhen: Multi-phase cooperative encounter authoring validates party size, reset and fail states.

systems.name: Community Event Creator
systems.doneWhen: Creators propose bounded scheduled events that pass review and resource budgets.

systems.name: Reward Designer
systems.doneWhen: Rewards are declarative, capped and authority-issued; creators cannot mint unrestricted value.

systems.name: Cutscene/Cinematic Creator
systems.doneWhen: Timeline authoring controls camera/dialogue/animation without blocking core simulation.

systems.name: Localization Creator
systems.doneWhen: Community translations are revisioned, attributable, reviewable and fallback-safe.

systems.name: Sandboxed Community Scripting
systems.doneWhen: Community logic runs in capability-limited sandbox with CPU/memory/event budgets and no secret access.

systems.name: Automated UGC Validator
systems.doneWhen: Static/semantic checks reject broken references, unsafe dimensions, invalid graphs and budget violations.

systems.name: Automated Playtest Bots
systems.doneWhen: Bots exercise navigation, quest completion and soft-lock probes against pinned staging revisions.

systems.name: UGC Security Scanner
systems.doneWhen: Scanner detects forbidden APIs, payload abuse, decompression bombs and suspicious package structure.

systems.name: UGC Moderation Pipeline
systems.doneWhen: UGC visibility is gated by moderation state, trust tier, appeal/audit trail and emergency takedown.

systems.name: UGC Provenance & Licensing
systems.doneWhen: Every asset/content revision records creator, source, hash, license/rights declaration and derivation.

systems.name: Creator Revenue Share
systems.doneWhen: Versioned attribution drives auditable creator rewards without trusting client-reported usage.

systems.name: Community Content Discovery
systems.doneWhen: Search/filter pages are paginated on demand and return metadata before heavy bytes.

systems.name: Community Recommendation Engine
systems.doneWhen: Recommendation uses explicit quality/safety signals with diversity caps and admin kill switch.

systems.name: UGC Lifecycle Manager
systems.doneWhen: Content moves through experimental/approved/live/legacy/archived states without orphaning dependents.

systems.name: Quest Runtime Engine
systems.doneWhen: Authority evaluates quest DAG deterministically and commits progress/rewards idempotently.

systems.name: NPC AI Runtime
systems.doneWhen: NPC simulation has deterministic tick budgets, sleeping/LOD and server-owned state.

systems.name: PvE Threat/Aggro System
systems.doneWhen: Threat tables, leashes and target selection are deterministic and reset safely.

systems.name: Dynamic Spawn Director
systems.doneWhen: Spawn budgets react to cell population/world state and remain reproducible for recovery.

systems.name: Deep Character Progression
systems.doneWhen: XP/mastery/talents are versioned, authority-written and migration-safe.

systems.name: Professions/Gathering/Crafting
systems.doneWhen: Gathering/crafting consumes authoritative inputs and feeds regional supply/demand.

systems.name: Procedural Itemization
systems.doneWhen: Seeded item rolls are reproducible, schema-versioned and capped by economy rules.

systems.name: Loot Authority & Ownership
systems.doneWhen: Drops and ownership are server-issued, idempotent and duplication resistant.

systems.name: Party / Raid / LFG Infrastructure
systems.doneWhen: Persistent parties, invites, roles, ready state and matchmaking preserve group affinity across shards.

systems.name: MMO Trust + LiveOps Control Plane
systems.doneWhen: Feature flags, trust signals, anti-abuse hooks, canaries, emergency disable and auditable admin actions.
